query: Civiqs Trump approval net rating September 2026 dashboard

results.content:
President Donald Trump’s approval rating is now underwater in every major swing state as the 2026 midterm elections approach, according to a new analysis released today by Newsweek. The data, based on Civiqs’ rolling tracking poll and measured on August 31, 2026, shows Trump facing a political landscape that has deteriorated significantly since the start of his second term in January 2025.
